name: Registration with invalid email is rejected [plainaddress]
description: Registration: required fields, email and password rules, duplicate emails, and that the response never leaks the password.
descriptionHtml: Registration: required fields, email and password rules, duplicate emails, and that the response never leaks the password.
statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: registration accepts syntactically invalid emails such as 'plainaddress' and returns 201 (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: invalid email 'plainaddress' must be rejected, got 201 {"first_name":"Edward","last_name":"Foster","email":"plainaddress","dob":"1990-01-15","phone":"0612345678","id":"01m74wsbjt2cekj26v8pwjwjy9","created_at":"2026-11-11 08:49:56","address":{"street":"Lesingel 8","house_number":"8","city":"Steensel","state":"Noord-Holland","country":"NL","postal_code":"1012AB"}}
assert 201 == 422
 +  where 201 = <Response [201]>.status_code
